# @three-ws/guardian

> Content safety + governance for AI agents in one import. IBM Granite Guardian risk classification, NVIDIA NemoGuard content moderation, autonomous-send caps, and a tamper-evident audit ledger — over the three.ws Trust Layer.

- Repository: https://github.com/nirholas/guardian
- Documentation: https://nirholas.github.io/guardian/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@three-ws/guardian
- License: Apache-2.0
- Part of three.ws: https://three.ws

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/guardian/blob/main/README.md): install, usage and full API reference
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/guardian/llms-full.txt): the entire README as plain text
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/guardian/blob/main/AGENTS.md): conventions for coding agents
- [Security policy](https://github.com/nirholas/guardian/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
